newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dlr closes on lows, taken down by Aust dollar.
newsitem.headline: NZ dlr closes on lows, taken down by Aust dollar.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed on Tuesday around its lows at US$0.6925/32 after trading in a range between 0.6928-49.
A chief dealer said the Kiwi "was on its lows mainly due to a 20 point drop in the Australian dollar".
"It was pretty quiet with profit-taking. Overnight Kiwi should find support at around 0.6910 on a base of 0.6910/20, and should continue to trade around 0.6920-50."
Another dealer said he expected the kiwi to trade in a 0.6920-50 range overnight.

"There is still a lot of interest from an issue base and demand from overseas. Some locals concerned about the political situation are happy to sell so they are the two factors but neither is particularly strong," the dealer said.
On the Trade Weighted Index the kiwi closed at 65.47 from 65.67 at the opening.-- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
